title: Coricancha andesite stonework

tellings.quote: the most the most impressive stonework in all of the ancient world.

plain: The fitted stone walls of Coricancha, an ancient temple site in Cusco, Peru, are built from andesite, a hard volcanic rock, and a researcher named Luke Caverns calls them "the most impressive stonework in all of the ancient world." Caverns says he has seen the work in person, and he brings it up as evidence that the old builders had more skill than we usually give them credit for.
